subject: Approval requested: PLG credit exception for Storix.ai
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Approval requested: PLG credit exception for Storix.ai

Hi Lauren / Laura / Aditya,

Quick ask — Storix.ai (PLG signup last week) is showing unusually high intent metrics and I recommend a time-limited credit uplift to accelerate conversion to a committed plan. Summary: 
- Requested: $30,000 in free credits applied to their account (internal credit unit = USD-backed)
- Trial window: 90 days from grant; prefer 120 if leadership agrees
- Rationale: product-led signal: 42M tokens used in the first 4 days, 12 active engineers, two teams building critical features that will move to paid in 60–90 days per their PM.
- Ask: leadership sign-off for this one-off exception (>$10k threshold). If approved, finance needs the credit_request_form completed (attached) and we’ll notify CS to set conversion milestones.

Risks/mitigations: cap credits to $30k, require billing card on file for auto-conversion, visibility to finance and CS, and 30-day check-in to reassess.

Attachments: credit_request_form.pdf (PDF, 245KB)

Thanks,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Approval requested: PLG credit exception for Storix.ai

Thanks Rishi — quick clarifying questions before I sign off:
1) Do we have a documented conversion play (CS owner + milestone) and who will own the post-trial negotiation?
2) Confirm whether Storix has a card on file and whether finance is comfortable with the $30k liability in a self-serve grant.
3) Can you add the HubSpot deal link and the forecasted ARR if they hit the projected usage?

If answers look clean I’m inclined to approve but want to make sure finance and CS are looped.

- Lauren

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Approval requested: PLG credit exception for Storix.ai

Adding color — I ran the usage projection and spoke to their PM (Rebecca). Key points: 
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/3241 (owner: R. Oliver)
- Forecasted ARR if they convert to a dedicated plan: ~$160k ARR in year 1; upside if they adopt embeddings product.
- Billing: they have a card on file but asked us not to charge until post-trial; finance confirmed they’ll accept card-on-file + manual capture after conversion.

I’ve attached a quick snapshot of the last 72h ingestion (usage_dashboard.png). I recommend the $30k credit with a firm 90-day expiry and a required 30/60-day check-in cadence with CS.

Attachment: usage_dashboard.png (PNG, 1.1MB)

- Aditya

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Approval requested: PLG credit exception for Storix.ai

Approved with conditions — I’ll sign off on the $30,000 credit exception. Conditions to include in the credit grant: 
- Expiration: 120 days from issuance (gives customer runway)
- Billing: card-on-file required; finance to set manual capture trigger on conversion
- CS: assign a named CSM (please put CS owner in HubSpot and schedule 30/60-day check-ins)

Finance and CS: please confirm you’ve received this and will action the controls above. Rishi — you have sign-off; proceed to notify the customer and file the paperwork.
